fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-05-12, a parked car of the complainant near Roja Colony Residential Colony was defaced and partly broken. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-05-12 at about 03:35. The complaint was lodged by Indhu Sri (9000000243). Elango Shankar (mobile 9000000317) was named as a possible person of interest. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complaint refers to Sanjay Mani, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000120. The complainant mentioned photographs and CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00379, as the mobile number 9000000317 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Unidentified persons allegedly damaged the property while it was unattended.
